name: Gauntwards' Call
descriptionTemplate: If released for the first time in this battle, generate 3 different {derived:Gaunts} into hand and gain [Block:Arg1] Shield. For every 4 permanent {derived:Gaunts} owned, upgrade 1 of them into "Conjoined {derived:Gaunts}". Otherwise, draw 3 {derived:Gaunt} cards.
lore:
Neither the human ear nor existing Silver Core Technology can, for now, extract any meaningful information from Pontos's hunting whistle.
Yet all those assimilated by Ebwynnos seem to adapt with remarkable swiftness, heeding the commands of the whistle.
